messages.content: Return one JSON object only, with no code fences, with "primary_topic", "topics" and "tracking_numbers". Topics: status_question, delay, return, damage, address_change, claim_followup, billing, other. Return tracking numbers as a plain list of strings exactly as written in the message.

Dear Business Owner,

Are you getting enough customers? Our agency helps logistics and courier companies like yours reach thousands of new online shops every month with targeted ads and email campaigns.

LIMITED OFFER: first month of campaigns at half price for the first 10 companies who reply to this email.

- Professional landing page
- 5,000 targeted business contacts
- Weekly reports

Reply YES and one of our consultants will call you within 24 hours.

Best regards,
The Nahda Digital team

To stop receiving these emails, reply STOP.
